title: Tiled-row layout and adaptive gutter system for virtual table (density token harmonization)
creator: Ava Park
description: Goal: Replace current single-row flow with a tiled-row rendering option that improves perceived density, reduces horizontal reflow, and standardizes spacing across density tokens. This ticket defines the visual language and interaction model and produces Figma components, specs for kernel-level padding/gutter tokens, and an accessibility-compliant resize affordance.
acceptance_criteria: Figma component for tiled-row table exists with three density tokens (compact, standard, spacious) and documented token values
Column gutter token names established and mapped to existing spacing scale
Keyboard-first column resize flow documented with ARIA announcements and focus states
Engineering has a clear spec for virtualization breakpoints and row tiling heuristics
QA checklist defined and sample dataset verified in Chrome, Safari, Firefox
design_notes: Tiled rows are a grid-like presentation where each logical row can contain stacked subcells for complex content (e.g., multi-line titles, inline badges, microcharts). The gutter system uses two tokens: token.table.gutter.horizontal and token.table.gutter.vertical. Use typography scale step -1 for compact mode. Visual rhythm should align to 8px baseline where possible.
decisions: Adopt 'tile' as the mode name rather than 'card' to emphasize row continuity
Expose two gutter tokens (horizontal/vertical) to simplify mapping to spacing scale
Default to keyboard resize UX that uses ArrowLeft/ArrowRight while holding Shift to move in 8px steps
Keep current column pin/unpin behaviours; pinned columns do not tile
engineering_notes: Runtime constraints: virtualization needs to support variable row heights; recommend measuring first 50 rows for histogram to estimate average height
KV cache and batching unaffected but kernel selection needs quantization-aware padding for microcharts
Provide a feature flag 'table_tile_mode' to gate rollout
qa_plan: Create automated visual tests for three densities using Storybook Chromatic
Manual keyboard and screenreader walkthroughs with NVDA and VoiceOver
Performance smoke: render 50k rows in headless env and capture time-to-interactive
rollout_plan: Phase 1 behind a flag for Beta customers; Phase 2 gradual rollout to 25% of host traffic with metrics on scroll jank and layout shift; Phase 3 enabled by default in next minor release.
accessibility_considerations: Use role='table' and role='rowgroup' semantics; each tiled row exposes role='row' and internal stacked regions use role='gridcell'
Resize handles must be focusable and announce delta in pixels; announce new column width after resize completes
Ensure color contrast for badges and microchart axis lines
open_questions: Should we expose tile-breakpoint as a responsive prop (px) or as density-driven boolean?
How will existing saved views and persisted column widths behave when switching between standard and tile modes?
